````text
# #3539: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S23, the Terminus Starships
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds The Last Voyage, The Far Vagabond and Phantom Shipyard, and the ten Terminus Starships they summon.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP5, SP6, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## Cards

| # | Card |
| --- | --- |
| #80 | The Last Voyage |
| #155 | The Far Vagabond |
| #157 | Phantom Shipyard |
| tokens | (the ten Terminus Starships) |

## What it builds on

- The foundation (#3535): every card's catalog entry, both faces and a stub script.
- Stinkyscape's Dormant Starship, Starship Pieces and launching (M02, R1852003)

## Readings (defaults; change one only with a ruling note)

- The ten Terminus Starships are tokens (`stinkyscapeplus-t-terminus-starship-<slug>`). Each is a Dormant Starship already holding Starship Pieces worth 5 to 12 mana in all, with a name of its own and art unlike the normal Starship's. They can't be launched by hand, except The Far Vagabond's, for (3) (Radiant (0)).
- #80 The Last Voyage: exiles its caster's hand, deck and board (Dormant cards included; Radiant: the opponent's board too), summons the ten Starships, and launches a random one now and another at the start of each of its caster's turns.
- #157 Phantom Shipyard: Dormant until launched. Each Start of Turn, it fuses in a random Starship Piece (Radiant: a Radiant one). Its Activate 3 exiles it and launches a Starship holding every piece it fused in. The designer's note binds: it works like the Starship card, edge cases included.

## The designer's text, verbatim

```text
**(4) The Last Voyage, Spell, Terminus, Mythic, Stinkyscape+, #80**
Exile your hand, deck, and board *{including dormant cards}*; summon 10 random **Terminus Starships** *{each one should have 5~12 mana worth of attachments, special names, different art than normal Starships, and cannot manually be launched}*. Now and the start of your turn launch a random one.
~~~
Exile your hand, deck, and board *{including dormant cards}*; summon 10 random **Terminus Starships** *{each one should have 5~12 mana worth of attachments, special names, different art than normal Starships, and cannot manually be launched}*. Now and the start of your turn launch a random one.
Also exile your opponents board.

**(4) The Far Vagabond, Unit, Mythic, Stinkyscape+, #155**
Summon a random **Terminus Starships**, it can be launched for (3) *{each one should have 5~12 mana worth of attachments, special names, different art than normal Starships}*
~~~
Summon a random **Terminus Starships**, it can be launched for (0) *{each one should have 5~12 mana worth of attachments, special names, different art than normal Starships}*

**(4) Phantom Shipyard Unit, Legendary, Stinkyscape+, #157**
0/0
**Start of turn: Fuse** a **random Starship Piece** into this
**Dormant until launched**
**Activate 3: Exile the shipyard and launch as a starship**
*{for ai it should be similar to the Starship card where it summons a starship and such idk work on edge cases}*
~~~
0/0
**Start of turn: Fuse** a **random Radiant Starship Piece** into this
**Dormant until launched**
**Activate 3: Exile the shipyard and launch as a starship**
```

## Done when

- [ ] Every card above plays its base and Radiant faces by its text and the readings, in its own script file (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/cNNN_slug.rs`, the stub the foundation made), with tests for both faces in the same file (CLAUDE.md rules 5 and 6). `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` was read first (rule 10).
- [ ] Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9). A script reads state only through the prelude's helpers. A missing verb or board fact goes into the engine with its test (CLAUDE.md, Architecture).
- [ ] Each decision the spec doesn't make has a ruling note numbered in this issue's block, a test named after it, and its paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (rule 3). The cards' §8 rows say what was built.
- [ ] Every prompt these cards open is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes for these cards, and `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `spec check` and `names --check` pass.
- [ ] Only these cards' catalog entries and §8 rows are edited (other parts edit theirs side by side), and the set stays `Held`: players see nothing until the release (part R).

Blocked by #3535

Part of #3534.
````

# Draft plan, issue #3539 (S23, the Terminus Starships) — planner's notes

## Found so far
- Base 5979dc4194 = F's pass 1 (#3535), on origin/bot/issue-3596. Stubs: `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/
  c080_the_last_voyage.rs`, `c155_the_far_vagabond.rs`, `c157_phantom_shipyard.rs`, ten `t_terminus_starship_<slug>.rs`.
  No §8.12 in spec yet; spec check on base: 248 problems, all F's missing R3535000–R3535002 notes.
- Catalog: #155 type Spell (no stats); #157 `exile`=3 param = F's "Activate: {key}:" uses convention (R482 says an
  Activate count is never a param; R1857003 "Activate 3:" = 3 uses a turn). #80 param `starships`=10. F lists #155's
  (3)/(0) as PRICE in tests/cross/params.rs r1748003 (literal, no param) -> script consts.
- Tokens: cost 3, tags Starship+Token, printed Legendary, Flying, Ranged, 0/0.
- Engine: `starship.rs` (hull flag, memory, launch_decl, launch_cost(state, player) used by cards tests — keep sig,
  fuse_dead_piece into `dormant_starship_of` (first), summon_dormant_starship/starship_zone backrow-middle-first).
  `subsystems/activate.rs:185` gives every Dormant Starship the engine launch; `:1168` is_launch -> pay_launch.
  Dormant: `triggers.rs:352` registers nothing; `restrictions::unaffected_by` passes it by; `state_check.rs::is_dying`
  KILLS a 0/0 Dormant card (Phantom Shipyard printed 0/0 would die at once!).
  Fuse (subsystems/fuse.rs ~1100) merges every StaticFlags field explicitly (exhaustive literal).
  Fused def: ingredients [ship, piece] (ship first), name joined, token only if all tokens.
- `for_rest_of_game` (effects/delay.rs:726) + `delayed` hook (pattern: stinkyscape/c126).
- `crate::query::starship_pieces()` (cards), `starship_pieces_query()` private in engine call_to_chaos_scape.rs.
- Card scripts may import other cards' consts (c154 imports c004::TERMINUS_CARDS). No helper files in scripts/.

## Design (decided)
- Terminus Starships: fixed loadouts (each token file `pub const PIECES`), hull + Dormant + `no_hand_launch`.
- Engine:
  1. StaticFlags.no_hand_launch: Option<bool>; StaticFlags.starship_yard: Option<StarshipYard{radiant}>; merge in fuse.rs.
  2. StarshipMemory.price: Option<i32> (per-instance hand-launch price).
  3. starship.rs: launch_decl -> Option; hand_launch_cost(state, card); fuse_piece_into(sink, ship_id, def_id, radiant);
     dormant_starships_of; hull_def_of; open_starship_zone; summon_hull; yard_at_turn_start.
  4. effects: summon_starships (blueprints, count, price, radiant, unique rounds), launch_random_starship(hulls),
     exile_board(player; Dormant + buried included; immune-to-spells still spared), launch_as_starship (shipyard).
  5. activate.rs: Dormant Starship whose text names wakesBy uses its text's ability; no launch when None.
  6. state_check is_dying: Dormant card judged by no health (mark still collects).
  7. turn.rs start_of_turn_brittle: yard_at_turn_start after awaken_at_turn_start.
- #157: Activate 3 (uses, R1857003), text "Activate 3:", drop `exile` param; free; can_activate needs >=1 piece.
- #155: param-less, consts 3/0; Spell.
- #80: exile hand, library (exile_bottom_of_library count), board (+opp board Radiant); summon_starships x starships;
  launch_random_starship now; for_rest_of_game step "launch".
